{
  "options": [
    {
      "id": "A",
      "name": "Dynamic PK Sub-Visits & Full Flowchart Alignment",
      "summary": "Create dynamic scheduled events for the seven PK subgroup visits triggered by RAND.PKSUB, add individualMayo subscore items, and build dedicated forms for all missing protocol assessments (ADA, PE, Labs, Vitals, ECG, Diary, Habits, CM).",
      "pros": [
        "Mirrors the protocol Schedule of Events 1:1 with explicit visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1.",
        "Dynamic visit rules ensure PK subgroup visits only appear for subjects who consented to the PK substudy (RAND.PKSUB = 'Yes').",
        "Captures granular Mayo subscores (Stool Frequency, Rectal Bleeding, PGA, Modified Endoscopy) to support modified Mayo and PGA secondary endpoints directly.",
        "Closes all data capture gaps identified in the flowchart (ADA, PE, clinical labs, vitals, ECG, C. diff, pregnancy, diary, substance use, general ConMeds)."
      ],
      "cons": [
        "Highest initial build effort due to adding 7 dynamic events, ~11 new forms, and associated edit checks and SDV rules.",
        "Increases visit schedule complexity on the EDC navigation bar for PK subgroup patients."
      ],
      "tradeoff": "This option gives complete protocol alignment with automated visit scheduling and visit-window tracking for PK subgroup subjects. It costs more upfront configuration and adds seven conditional events to the casebook structure.",
      "recommended": true
    },
    {
      "id": "B",
      "name": "Repeating PK Log on Parent Visits & Consolidated Forms",
      "summary": "Keep the existing 11-visit structure by collecting the 48 h, 144 h, 240 h, and 480 h PK samples on repeating PK forms within parent visits V2, V7, and V8, while adding consolidated forms for the missing flowchart assessments and Mayo subscores.",
      "pros": [
        "Avoids creating 7 new events in the visit schedule, keeping the event matrix compact.",
        "Simplifies cross-visit edit checks and SDV plan maintenance since all PK data stays within V2–V9.",
        "Still captures all newly required endpoints (Mayo subscores, AESI, detailed TB/Virology assays, ADA, PE, and missing safety/diary data)."
      ],
      "cons": [
        "Deviates from the protocol flowchart nomenclature (V2.1–V2.3, V7.1–V7.3, V8.1), which can confuse sites entering data days after the parent visit.",
        "Loses automatic visit-level window calculation and overdue visit tracking for the intermediate PK sampling days (Day 2, Day 6, Day 10, etc.).",
        "Requires complex edit checks on the PK form to prevent non-PK-substudy patients from entering post-dose sub-visit timepoints."
      ],
      "tradeoff": "This option keeps the visit schedule simple by tucking intermediate PK samples into parent visits V2, V7, and V8. It sacrifices visit-level window tracking and clear visual prompts for sites to collect the Day 2, 6, and 10 PK draws.",
      "recommended": false
    },
    {
      "id": "C",
      "name": "Delta-Only Incremental Build (Exclude Pre-existing Flowchart Gaps)",
      "summary": "Add the 7 dynamic PK subgroup visits and implement only the explicit protocol text amendments (Mayo subscores, AESI flag, TB/Virology detail, ADA at V3, Diary at V2, infusion & endoscopy window checks) without building historical missing forms unless explicitly modified.",
      "pros": [
        "Minimizes build scope and validation time by addressing only active amendment diffs and direct form additions (ADA, PE, Diary).",
        "Preserves existing data management workflows if Labs, Vitals, ECG, Pregnancy, and C. diff are already captured via external central lab/ePRO transfers.",
        "Provides accurate dynamic visit scheduling for the PK substudy visits V2.1–V8.1."
      ],
      "cons": [
        "Leaves clinical labs, vital signs, ECG, pregnancy, urine drug screen, and general concomitant medications out of the EDC casebook if no external vendor database exists.",
        "Risks audit findings if the study relies solely on EDC for all flowchart procedures listed in CH-18."
      ],
      "tradeoff": "This option speeds up deployment by building only the direct amendment deltas and assuming standard labs and vitals live in external vendor transfers. It risks missing required clinical data if those external data streams are not actually in place.",
      "recommended": false
    }
  ]
}
